𝕽𝖎𝖌𝖍𝖙 𝖉𝖊𝖆𝖗 𝖋𝖗𝖎𝖊𝖓𝖉,
	𝖎𝖋 𝖞𝖔𝖚 𝖜𝖎𝖘𝖍 𝖙𝖔 𝖗𝖊𝖛𝖎𝖛𝖊 𝖞𝖔𝖚𝖗 𝖆𝖑𝖑𝖎𝖌𝖆𝖙𝖔𝖗 𝖞𝖔𝖚 𝖒𝖚𝖘𝖙 𝖆𝖈𝖙 𝖜𝖎𝖙𝖍 𝖍𝖆𝖘𝖙𝖊! 𝕿𝖍𝖊 𝖐𝖎𝖓𝖌 𝖍𝖎𝖒𝖘𝖊𝖑𝖋 𝖎𝖘 𝖆 𝖉𝖆𝖘𝖙𝖆𝖗𝖉𝖑𝖞 𝖘𝖎𝖗𝖊 (𝖋𝖊𝖆𝖗 𝖓𝖔𝖙; 𝖓𝖔𝖓𝖊 𝖘𝖍𝖆𝖑𝖑 𝖘𝖊𝖊 𝖙𝖍𝖎𝖘 𝖑𝖊𝖙𝖙𝖊𝖗 𝖇𝖚𝖙 𝖙𝖍𝖔𝖚) 𝖆𝖓𝖉, 𝖑𝖎𝖐𝖊 𝖆 𝖈𝖚𝖓𝖓𝖎𝖓𝖌 𝖘𝖓𝖆𝖐𝖊, 𝖉𝖔𝖊𝖘 𝖍𝖎𝖉𝖊 𝖙𝖍𝖊 𝖒𝖊𝖉𝖎𝖈𝖆𝖑 𝖎𝖓𝖌𝖗𝖊𝖉𝖎𝖊𝖓𝖙𝖘 𝖙𝖔 𝖞𝖔𝖚𝖗 𝖉𝖊𝖘𝖎𝖗𝖊𝖉 𝖈𝖚𝖗𝖊. 𝕺, 𝖙𝖔 𝖇𝖊 𝖆 𝖑𝖔𝖜𝖑𝖞 𝖕𝖊𝖆𝖘𝖆𝖓𝖙 𝖎𝖓 𝖔𝖚𝖗 𝖙𝖎𝖒𝖊... 𝖙𝖗𝖊𝖆𝖙𝖊𝖉 𝖑𝖎𝖐𝖊 𝖓𝖔𝖙𝖍𝖎𝖓𝖌 𝖇𝖚𝖙 - 𝖇𝖚𝖙 𝖈𝖗𝖔𝖈𝖔𝖉𝖎𝖑𝖊𝖘 𝖎𝖓 𝖍𝖎𝖘 𝖋𝖎𝖑𝖙𝖍𝖞 𝖒𝖔𝖆𝖙! 𝕾𝖔 𝕴 𝖕𝖑𝖊𝖆𝖉 𝖞𝖔𝖚 𝖌𝖔𝖔𝖉 𝖋𝖊𝖑𝖑𝖔𝖜; 𝖞𝖔𝖚𝖗 𝖆𝖑𝖑𝖎𝖌𝖆𝖙𝖔𝖗 𝖍𝖆𝖘 𝖗𝖊𝖜𝖆𝖗𝖉𝖊𝖉 𝖚𝖘 𝖌𝖗𝖊𝖆𝖙𝖑𝖞 𝖎𝖓 𝖇𝖆𝖙𝖙𝖑𝖊.. 𝖑𝖊𝖙 𝖓𝖔𝖙 𝖍𝖎𝖒 𝖋𝖆𝖑𝖑 𝖙𝖔 𝖙𝖍𝖊 𝖈𝖔𝖗𝖗𝖚𝖕𝖙𝖎𝖔𝖓 𝖔𝖋 𝖔𝖚𝖗 𝖘𝖙𝖆𝖙𝖊. 𝕲𝖊𝖙 𝖞𝖔𝖚𝖗𝖘𝖊𝖑𝖋 𝖌𝖔𝖎𝖓𝖌, 𝖆𝖓𝖉 𝖌𝖔𝖔𝖉 𝖑𝖚𝖈𝖐 𝖚𝖓𝖙𝖔 𝖞𝖔𝖚!
	𝖄𝖔𝖚𝖗 𝖌𝖔𝖔𝖉 𝖋𝖗𝖎𝖊𝖓𝖉.

main road.name: 𝕄𝔸𝕀ℕ ℝ𝕆𝔸𝔻
main road.description: You slip inside. Rows of empty bunk beds line the walls. The castle guards must be out on patrol! On a wooden table in the center, a guard carelessly left behind a flickering torch.

forested road.name: 𝔽𝕆ℝ𝔼𝕊𝕋𝔼𝔻 ℝ𝕆𝔸𝔻
forested road.description: You slip inside. Rows of empty bunk beds line the walls. The castle guards must be out on patrol! On a wooden table in the center, a guard carelessly left behind a flickering torch.

barracks.name: 𝔾𝕌𝔸ℝ𝔻 𝔹𝔸ℝℝ𝔸ℂ𝕂𝕊
barracks.description: You slip inside. Rows of empty bunk beds line the walls. The castle guards must be out on patrol! On a wooden table in the center, a guard carelessly left behind a flickering torch.

items.name: torch
items.description: A warm, flickering torch... use it to light up dark rooms!

courtyard.name: 𝕋ℍ𝔼 ℂ𝕆𝕌ℝ𝕋𝕐𝔸ℝ𝔻
courtyard.description: A massive, open-air stone courtyard. Fountains sit frozen in the chill night air. Pathways branch out in all directions. To the west is an armory, to the east is a dark staircase leading down into the dungeons, and north leads deeper into the palace.

armory.name: 𝕋ℍ𝔼 𝔸ℝ𝕄𝕆ℝ𝕐
armory.description: Racks of iron shields and broken spears fill this dusty room. Hanging on the rack is a pristine, sharp steel sword. This might come in handy if you encounter any hostile guards!

items.name: sword
items.description: A light arming sword - can be used to deal significant and consistent damage to your foes!

dungeon.name: 𝕋ℍ𝔼 𝔻𝕌ℕ𝔾𝔼𝕆ℕ
dungeon.description: It is pitch black down here, but you can find your way around. Chains hang from the damp stone walls. In the furthest skeleton-filled cell, you spot a heavy golden vault key sitting on a wall hook.

items.name: key
items.description: A rusted key... with remnants of oddly exorbiant jewels on it...

throne_room.name: 𝕋ℍ𝔼 𝕋ℍℝ𝕆ℕ𝔼 ℝ𝕆𝕆𝕄
throne_room.description: Magnificent velvet banners hang from high stone pillars, and a massive gold throne sits at the end of the hall. A ferocious Elite Guard stands blocking the northern doorway! (Tip: Make sure you have picked up your sword before trying to pass).

vault.name: 𝕋ℍ𝔼 ℝ𝕆𝕐𝔸𝕃 𝕋ℝ𝔼𝔸𝕊𝕌ℝ𝔼 𝕍𝔸𝕌𝕃𝕋
vault.description: You have successfully sneaked past the guards and made it into the King's inner sanctum! Chests of gold glitter all around you. In the center of the room sits a velvet pillow holding a glowing blue elixir: 'The Cure'. Take it and save your family!

items.name: a cure?
items.description: A scathed but once previously polished vial of a very low viscosity, iridescent liquid. At first it doesn't appear to look like much - more like muddy groundwater than a potion. The cork at the top seems not to be stained the way you would expect it to be, but rather looks as if it were freshly coated with a dull sheen like a seal after a horrid oil spill. But when you hold it up to the faint glow of the vault and some of its fluorescent jewels, you can see that inside the fluid there are tiny sparks that dance as you swish the supposed elixir around. Sometimes you see faint yellow and turquoise flakes, but the mixture itself seems rather... angry. There are clusters of light that seem to reflect the colour of fresh blood in the sun, vibrating as if they wanted to be released that instant. For something that is magical, it looks almost dead - almost.. vegetative. What an odd.. thing... what an odd.. cure!

deep vault.name: 𝕋ℍ𝔼 𝔻𝔼𝔼ℙ 𝕍𝔸𝕌𝕃𝕋
deep vault.description:
Wasn't that it? Why did you go deeper? Haven't you found... the cure? 

 	In the middle of the room you see a strange object. It looks almost like the shape of a human heart. But something is off. You shouldn't be able to see it. No light enters the room after the heaviness of the vault door anchors shut behind you. Your torch has gone out. 

	 The heart is glowing. But not from the inside. You can tell that although it seems like the - the object - is illuminating the room it does not seem to radiate. The surface of it is shiny - perhaps made of gold. But as you peer into the nooks and crannies of the arteries and vessels you can tell that they are dark.

	It's moving. The thing now looks inflated - bulging and disfigured. Really, it wasn't a large object. Then, you notice that it has started spewing liquid out of its channels. The same, murky and nearly iridescent liquid inside the vial you just found. It sputters with the consistency of spoiled milk. Red clots dance in the fluid, clouded over by the liquid itself the same way cataracts obscure the vision - though the yellow and turquoise dots are no longer present. 

	In proud, large letters above the monstrosity you see, etched:

		𝕿𝖍𝖊 𝕲𝖔𝖑𝖉𝖊𝖓 𝕳𝖊𝖆𝖗𝖙 𝖔𝖋 𝖙𝖍𝖊 𝕶𝖎𝖓𝖌


You have the king's blood. The king's blood is the cure. He must be magical, and good, and he must save you, your alligator, and..
Where is the cure? Why has it gone rotten? Why have you gone so far - what do you want? Are you not satisfied? Are you rotten too, like the.. King?
	So why is his heart here?
	Does he have no heart?
	Or did he trade his heart in just to feel saved - good? Did he mix his blood in with the real cure to save himself? Or did he want to taint the cure... BE the cure? Is there an antidote to his blood? What could combat the blood of corruption, but the blood of sincerity?

		...Too far gone?

		Are you?/n/n/nTake the knife. Let yourself bleed, because he will not bleed for you. Drop it into the vial.
